status: identity check of the model this lane scored against the frozen headline model

pair_level_two_derivations.what_was_compared: the per-pair top_target and deletion_drop columns and the per-pair model score, between this lane's derivation and a second one that calls the library's steps in the order crispri.score_published calls them; equal within 1e-12

against_the_committed_headline.note: data/results/crispri_published.json records aggregate AUPRCs and no per-pair column, so a pair-level diff against the committed file is not possible. This compares the weighted AUPRC of each model on each population at the four decimals the file records

rule_1_cell_membership.name: cell membership (crispri.annotate's `cells` argument, default crispri.MODEL_CELLS)
rule_1_cell_membership.what_it_decides: whether the two deletion columns are computed for a pair at all. A pair whose own cell line is not in MODEL_CELLS takes the branch (0.0, []) and both columns are zero

rule_2_answered.name: answered (the non-model column `deletion_answered`, set when the sweep returned any value for this gene in this pair's own cell)
rule_2_answered.what_it_decides: whether the sweep actually had something to say about the pair, so that a drop of zero can be told apart from a table that was silent

the_gap.what_they_are: pairs in a model cell line for which the deletion columns were computed but the sweep returned no value, so top_target and deletion_drop are both 0.0. The headline's cell-membership count includes them among the pairs 'with a deletion value'; the answered count does not

coverage_rules_reconciled.which_rule_the_frozen_model_applied: cell membership. The frozen model's two columns exist for every pair in a model cell line and are zero elsewhere; `deletion_answered` is not a model column and no scorer reads it. So this lane's 'ours' IS the frozen headline model, not a different feature join, which the AUPRC comparison above checks at four decimals on both populations rather than asserts

code_cleanliness.counting_path_is_computed: the transitive import closure of this script over the repository's own package, computed from the files' import statements at write time, not a hand-written list

the_registrations_own_dirt.whose: lane-s8, untracked in this shared checkout when the registration was stamped
the_registrations_own_dirt.why_it_could_not_enter: neither path is on the counting path computed above, and the registration reads no value from either; the registration writes no measurement at all

verdict: the model scored by scripts/re2g_paired.py is the frozen headline model: no pair differs in either deletion column or in its score between two independent derivations, and every model's weighted AUPRC equals the committed headline's on both populations

sources.accession: EngreitzLab/CRISPR_comparison training and held-out benchmark tables

exclusions: nothing excluded: both derivations run on the published pair sets whole
